chrome.tagline: Dedicated driver. No sorting hubs. Direct delivery.

fastDispatch.title: Fast Dispatch
fastDispatch.desc: A named driver is assigned within minutes of confirmation. Pickup is usually within 30–60 minutes in major business areas.

directPointToPoint.title: Direct Point-to-Point
directPointToPoint.desc: No sorting hubs, no warehouses, no shared loads. Your item stays with one driver from pickup to dropoff.

chainOfCustody.title: Chain of Custody
chainOfCustody.desc: The sender and the recipient each confirm the handover with a one-time code. Every handover is recorded with time and GPS.

realTimeProof.title: Real-time Proof
realTimeProof.desc: You get a live tracking link during the run, then a Chain of Custody certificate the moment it is delivered.

whatClientsUseThisFor.heading: What Clients Use This For
whatClientsUseThisFor.body: Same-day contracts and tenders into government offices. Spare parts moved straight from supplier to a site that's down. Documents that need to be in someone's hands — not a mailbox — by a specific hour.

needItNow.heading: Need it Now?
needItNow.body: Our dispatchers are standing by to assign a dedicated driver to your request. No waiting for the next truck.

dubai.title: Dubai Dispatch.
dubai.subtitle: Fast inter-emirate transport starting from Dubai. Pickup typically within 30–60 minutes for immediate dispatch to Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and beyond.

content.0: Dubai is the heart of UAE commerce, and when logistics fail, business stops. Nokael moves urgent items out of Dubai to other emirates — one driver, no hubs, no sorting delays.
content.1: Our drivers are strategically positioned across Dubai—from Downtown and DIFC to Jebel Ali and Dubai Marina—to ensure rapid response times. We don't use sorting hubs; your item goes from the pickup point directly to the delivery destination.
content.2: Whether it's a critical document for a government office in Abu Dhabi or a forgotten passport for a flight in Sharjah, our Dubai dispatch team is ready 24/7.

abuDhabi.title: Abu Dhabi Dispatch.
abuDhabi.subtitle: Premium inter-emirate logistics from the capital. Dedicated drivers for direct transport to Dubai and the Northern Emirates.

content.0: Abu Dhabi requires a higher level of logistics precision. Nokael serves the capital's most demanding delivery needs with dedicated transport for government, corporate, and private clients.
content.1: Our Abu Dhabi dispatch network covers the entire city, including Al Reem Island, Khalifa City, and the Industrial areas. We specialize in the Abu Dhabi ↔ Dubai corridor, offering the fastest possible transit times between the two major hubs.
content.2: With Nokael, you get a dedicated driver who understands the urgency of your mission. No shared loads, no delays, just direct inter-emirate delivery.

document.title: Document & Legal.
document.subtitle: Secure, hand-to-hand transport for sensitive documents, contracts, and legal tenders across all emirates.

content.0: In the legal and corporate world, some documents are too important for standard courier services. Nokael provides a premium document dispatch service that prioritizes security and chain of custody.
content.1: Our drivers handle your sensitive materials with the utmost care, providing hand-to-hand delivery from the sender directly to the recipient. We understand the critical nature of legal deadlines and government tender submissions.
content.2: Custody changes hands with a one-time code at pickup and another at delivery. You can follow the run on a live tracking link, and you get a Chain of Custody certificate showing who held the document, where and when, with GPS for every handover.

spareParts.title: Spare Parts Logistics.
spareParts.subtitle: Emergency transport for critical machinery, automotive, and industrial parts. Direct from supplier to site.

content.0: When machinery breaks down or a vehicle is off the road, every minute costs money. Nokael provides emergency spare parts logistics for the industrial and automotive sectors across the UAE.
content.1: We specialize in the rapid transport of critical components that are too urgent for traditional freight. Our drivers can pick up directly from suppliers or warehouses and deliver straight to the site where the part is needed.
content.2: From heavy industrial components to delicate electronic parts, we get your operations back on track as quickly as possible.

legal.title: Legal Document Courier.
legal.subtitle: Same-day hand-to-hand delivery for law firms in DIFC, ADGM and across the UAE, with proof of every handover you can put on file.

content.0: A signed agreement, a court filing or a power of attorney cannot go through a sorting hub. Nokael assigns one named driver who carries your document from your office straight to the recipient: DIFC to ADGM, a court registry, a notary or a client's office.
content.1: Custody changes hands with one-time codes. Your team gives the driver a code at pickup, and the recipient confirms delivery with their own code. Each handover is recorded with the time and GPS location, and you can follow the run on a live tracking link.
content.2: When the document arrives, you receive a Chain of Custody certificate: who held it, where and when, and the total time in custody. Keep it on the matter file as proof of delivery.

legal.proofHeading: Proof you can put on the file.

proofPoints.0: One named driver, your document only. No hubs, no shared vans.
proofPoints.1: One-time code at pickup and at delivery, so custody only passes to the right person.
proofPoints.2: Live tracking link while the document is on the road.
proofPoints.3: Chain of Custody certificate with time and GPS for every handover.

medical.title: Medical Sample Courier.
medical.subtitle: Same-day direct delivery of lab samples, specimens and medical records between clinics, labs and hospitals across the UAE, with a record of every handover.

content.0: A sample going to an outside lab should not wait in a sorting hub or ride around in a shared van. Nokael assigns one named driver who collects from your clinic and drives straight to the lab, hospital or pharmacy, across town or between Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
content.1: Custody changes hands with one-time codes. Your team gives the driver a code at pickup, and the lab confirms receipt with their own code. Each handover is recorded with the time and GPS location, and you can follow the run on a live tracking link.
content.2: Samples travel in the packaging your clinic prepares, such as a sealed cool box. Tell dispatch about temperature or handling needs when you book. After delivery you receive a Chain of Custody certificate showing who held the package, where and when, and the total time in custody.

proofPoints.2: Live tracking link while the sample is on the road.
proofPoints.3: Chain of Custody certificate with time and GPS for every handover, and the total time in custody.

hr.title: HR Document Courier.
hr.subtitle: Same-day hand-to-hand delivery of passports, visa paperwork and employment contracts between your office, your employees and your PRO, with proof of every handover.

content.0: Passports, Emirates ID paperwork, signed offer letters and attested certificates are hard to replace. Nokael assigns one named driver who carries them straight from your office to the employee, your PRO, a typing centre or another branch.
content.1: Custody changes hands with one-time codes. Your team gives the driver a code at pickup, and the recipient confirms delivery with their own code. Each handover is recorded with the time and GPS location, and you can follow the run on a live tracking link.
content.2: After delivery you receive a Chain of Custody certificate: who held the documents, where and when, and the total time in custody. Keep it on the employee file to show when a passport left your office and who received it.

finance.title: Banking Document Courier.
finance.subtitle: Same-day hand-to-hand delivery of cheques, bank guarantees and signed agreements between banks, finance teams and clients across the UAE, with proof of every handover.

content.0: A cheque, a bank guarantee or a signed facility agreement should not pass through a sorting hub. Nokael assigns one named driver who carries the original from your office straight to the bank branch, the client or the other party: DIFC to ADGM, or across town.
content.1: Custody changes hands with one-time codes. Your team gives the driver a code at pickup, and the recipient confirms delivery with their own code. Each handover is recorded with the time and GPS location, and you can follow the run on a live tracking link.
content.2: After delivery you receive a Chain of Custody certificate: who held the document, where and when, and the total time in custody. Keep it with the transaction record as proof of when the original left and who received it.
